sources.quote: HD 82886, also named Illyrian, is a star with an orbiting exoplanet located in the constellation Leo Minor.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.8 solar radii and 1.95 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,322 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
